name: wardrobe
description: Connect Codex to your Garderobe wardrobe: today's board, outfit recommendations, inventory, laundry and receipted wardrobe commands through the Garderobe MCP server and its own OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Read today's outfit board, ask for validated recommendations, browse the inventory and laundry, and make the changes you ask for through Garderobe's own commands: each applied change returns a receipt and can be undone, and a change the server keeps for your confirmation waits in the Garderobe app. Restrictions can only be lifted by you in the app.
defaultPrompt: Use Wardrobe to show me today's outfit board.
Use Wardrobe to suggest three outfits for tomorrow.
